backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing Nakshatra CRUD operations with admin-only write access, public read access, user profile management, blob storage for images, and access control via MixinAuthorization and MixinStorage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining AdminActor type with state fields (nextImageId, nakshatraMap, imageStore, userProfiles) and a run function that currently returns the actor unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of error handling and retry logic in useQueries.ts to gracefully handle canister initialization delays with user-friendly loading states.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries of all frontend source files describing components, hooks, pages, and utilities with focus on initialization-aware error handling and astronomical calculations.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with cosmic purple/violet primary colors and cyan accents.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with 'Star Field Explorer' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, nakshatra detail, and admin pages (wrapped in AdminGuard), plus ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that renders PasscodeEntry if not authenticated, otherwise renders children for protecting admin routes.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogoutButto: Button component with lock icon that clears admin authentication and shows a toast notification when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Banner displaying current nakshatra with moon icon, clickable link to detail page, and expandable pada details section showing navamsa sign, title, degree range, and interpretive description.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with Caffeine.ai attribution link including UTM parameters and dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with 'Star Field Explorer' branding, moon icon, and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin pages.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing consistent page structure with Header, main content area using Outlet, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Displays a grid of all 27 Nakshatras as clickable cards with images, highlighting the current Nakshatra based on the Moon's position. Fetches Nakshatra data and images from the backend canister with loading states.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: Provides an image upload component with 4:5 aspect ratio validation, preview functionality, and converts uploaded files to Uint8Array for backend storage. Includes progress indication and error handling.
frontend/src/components/PasscodeEntry.ts: Renders a passcode entry form for admin authentication with validation, error display, and loading states. Uses the usePasscodeAuth hook to manage authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control with admin token from URL parameters. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: Provides the current Nakshatra based on the Moon's position, automatically refreshing every 5 minutes using the nakshatraEngine utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: Provides a mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data and optionally replacing images, with automatic query cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasscodeAuth.ts: Manages simple passcode-based admin authentication using sessionStorage, with cross-component state synchronization via custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching Nakshatra data from the backend actor, including getAllNakshatras, getNakshatraByName, and getImage. Implements error transformation, initialization error detection, and exponential backoff retry logic for canister availability issues.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a dark-themed design system, defining colors for backgrounds, foregrounds, primary/secondary colors, borders, and chart colors using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing individual Nakshatra entries with form fields for all properties including description, deity, symbol, characteristics, and four padas. Handles image uploads and updates via mutation hooks with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying a grid of all Nakshatras with thumbnails and edit buttons. Shows loading states during canister initialization, error alerts for failures, and includes logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page with introductory text explaining Nakshatras, displaying the current Nakshatra banner and a grid of all 27 Nakshatras. Handles initialization loading states and error display.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page for individual Nakshatras showing comprehensive information including description, deity, symbol, characteristics, and four padas with tabs. Merges backend data with fallback pada data and displays images with loading/error states.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Defines Nakshatra data structures and implements astronomical calculations for determining Moon's position in Nakshatras using Julian Day and ecliptic longitude formulas based on Jean Meeus' algorithms.
frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts: Contains detailed descriptive data for each Nakshatra pada (quarter), including degree ranges, Navamsa signs, titles, and extensive interpretive descriptions for astrological analysis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and sessionStorage, supporting both standard query strings and hash-based routing with persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking known issues with backend canister initialization causing Nakshatra loading failures, along with pending feature requests to fix error handling and canister startup behavior.
